assessment_scope: Fresh review of supporting-subject correction within INTEGRATE-1, under design-review-cleanup-delivered-package and delivery-review-cleanup-integration. This records a concrete incomplete-fix finding before correction; complete accumulated cleanup review and final proof remain pending.

findings.evidence: Severity: major. Location: scripts/validation_selection.py:_support_subject_paths and scripts/validate-record-store.mjs complete-set validation. record-store inspect status inspected validates each record/envelope but never invokes format.set. Reproduction /tmp/cleanup-support-reference-repro.py creates the existing valid supporting_subject_repo fixture, changes material-decisions.decisions[0].source_refs to evidence.json/id unknown-check, calls public select_validation and gets status ok/no blockers. The existing validate-record-store.mjs rejects the exact same fixture with exit1. Thus a structurally valid but cross-reference-invalid store supplies supporting membership contrary to approved Validation.
findings.required_outcome: Run existing complete-set validation on the same in-memory inspected files from which exact Subject paths are extracted before admitting support. Safe resolution: narrowly extend existing repository validator to output validated Subject paths after its existing formatFor(...).set, keeping ordinary/revision behavior and unknown option rejection; have selector consume that result with per-invocation caching. Add dangling-reference negative regression and direct ordinary/new-mode argument tests. Do not separately validate and reinspect changing state, add a parallel record parser/schema, or weaken reserved-path checks. Then rerun focused and complete allocated proof.

resolution.rationale: Independently reassessed final correction: the existing validator uses one inspected files map, runs complete stored-format set/reference validation, then extracts exact Subject paths from that returned parsed Map. Selector admits only safe explicitly referenced nonreserved paths, preserves reserved registration/unknown/mixed/malformed rejection and reuses only per invocation. Seven direct tests cover changed/deleted support, record preservation, stale membership, mixed unknowns, invalid schema, dangling EntryRefs, reserved paths, escaping links and strict validator options. Independent dangling-reference reproduction now blocks. All 1639 complete selected+broad execution rows passed on unchanged final engineering subjects. Original finding evidence and reviewed identities are preserved.

independence_basis: Independent delegated reviewer did not author the selector correction, tests, Design or delivery plan; reproduction used temporary synthetic fixtures only.
limitations: Only this correction assessment is concluded. Original cleanup-supporting-evidence-selection remains open, and no final whole-change approval, Verify or PR readiness is claimed.
Final checklist and complete local/broad results remain required after correction.
rationale: Spec alignment and error handling — concern: approved Validation requires the complete registered set to validate before supporting membership is admitted. _support_subject_paths only checks record-store inspect success. That API parses individual records and the snapshot envelope but does not run validateV3Set reference closure.

Tests and edges — concern: current five tests cover syntax-invalid records, reserved paths, mixed unknown paths, changed/deleted support and escaping links, but not a schema-valid dangling EntryRef. Independent public select_validation reproduction changed a decision source_ref to evidence.json/id unknown-check; selection returned ok with no blockers while validate-record-store.mjs rejected the same set.

Architecture and compatibility: reuse scripts/validate-record-store.mjs same in-memory files after existing formatFor(...).set. A second independent validate-then-inspect subprocess risks validating one snapshot and reading another; preserve the same-snapshot boundary. Retain normal validator output and strict option rejection.

Security/derived/scope: no implementation modified by reviewer. Existing scheduled metadata validation would still detect the invalid set, so this is not a false full-pass claim; it is failure of the newly required admission boundary and an unproved malformed-set case. Final validation was stopped by owner before correction; no interrupted run counts as passed.
summary: Supporting-subject routing trusts per-record inspection without the required complete-set cross-reference validation.
